item.title: What to Know About Iran’s Economic Ties With Gulf Countries
item.description: The United Arab Emirates, Iran’s most important regional trading partner, announced a total embargo on transactions with Tehran on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump and Canada’s Carney Seem to Make Progress on a Tariff Deal, but Questions Linger
item.description: After a deadline extension, the latest U.S. tariff threats seemed headed toward resolution on Wednesday, but questions lingered about what Canada would give up, and what it would get in exchange.

item.title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers
item.description: Two high-profile cases that had spurred international condemnation of the country’s conduct in Gaza were transferred to the military police. Such investigations have rarely led to convictions.

item.title: Chinese Start-Up Lands Reusable Rocket for the First Time
item.description: The milestone by the private company, LandSpace, could put China closer to challenging SpaceX’s rule in lower-cost spaceflight.

item.title: How the Iran War Made Africa’s Richest Man Even Richer
item.description: Africans have turned to one of their own for fuel as the world’s supplies run low. But they are not the only ones with the continent’s richest man on speed dial.

item.title: Trump, With Limited Options in Iran, Tries Economic Pressure — Again
item.description: Iran has survived decades of sanctions. Faced with more, it is likely to escalate rather than surrender, analysts said.

item.title: U.A.E. Announces Halt to Trade With Iran Amid Trump’s Push To Isolate Tehran
item.description: The Emirates has long been a major trading hub for Iran, and analysts say it has been key to Iranian efforts to evade international sanctions, which Emirati officials deny.

item.title: Ukraine’s Ex-Defense Minister Calls for Election, Cementing Break With Zelensky
item.description: Mykhailo Fedorov, a popular young leader who was fired last month, said Russia should not be allowed to dictate when Ukrainians can choose their next government.

item.title: North Korean Official Dismisses Reduced Drills Between US and South Korea
item.description: Kim Yo-jong, a powerful adviser and sister of Kim Jong-un, also said she was “unaware” of any communication with Washington, contradicting President Trump’s claim her brother had responded to his outreach.

item.title: מתקיפות ישראליות בלבנון נהרגו 9, אומרים גורמי בריאות
item.description: משרד הבריאות הלבנוני אמר כי מספר ילדים נהרגו בשביתה במהלך הלילה, אחד הפיגועים הקטלניים ביותר מזה חודשים. צבא ישראל אמר שהוא מכוון לתשתיות של חיזבאללה.
